title: MIR 3.2.4 unified research cost curves
migration_impact: Adds stable startup settings for an additive per-level cost increment. Defaults are zero, existing setting IDs remain stable, unchanged external formulas remain byte-for-byte unchanged, and no model-selection dropdown is introduced.

backport_disposition.factorio-2.1: canonical implementation and release on dev/main as MIR 3.2.4
backport_disposition.factorio-2.0: project after the 2.5.0 stabilization decision; independently qualify as 2.5.1 only if a confirmed defect requires that release, otherwise queue for 2.6
